subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volume & peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Zhang <oliver@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volume & peak TPS

Thanks for taking the time today, Oliver — great conversation. Quick recap and a couple of asks to make sure our estimate matches your needs: 

Summary from call:
- Use case: customer support augmentation + summarization for knowledge base articles.
- Expected traffic pattern: steady baseline with marketing-driven launch spikes.

Open items for pricing/ops:
1) Expected monthly token volume (ballpark or range).
2) Peak sustained TPS during spikes and typical concurrency.
3) Initial monthly budget range and any target unit economics (target $/1M tokens).

From our side: Redwood Hosted can serve this use case with streaming responses and automatic prefix/KV caching to reduce token consumption. We typically provide a back-of-the-envelope estimate once we have the monthly token range and peak TPS so we can size both costs and latency.

Could you confirm the three items above? If you prefer, share a sample hour-level traffic estimate (tokens/min or TPS) and we can run a quick cost/latency projection.

Next steps:
- I attached our hosted pricing sheet and the demo recording from today.
- If numbers look reasonable, let’s book a 30-min follow-up with Ben (SE) to validate the peak TPS and possible perf tuning.

Thanks — looking forward to your numbers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-sheet.xlsx
Attachment: demo-recording-20260720.mp4

From: Oliver Zhang <oliver@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volume & peak TPS

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. Confirming rough numbers from our side after the call and an internal sync this morning:

- Expected monthly token volume: ~30M tokens/month (range 25M-35M depending on adoption).
- Peak TPS: short spikes up to ~40 TPS during launch promos, more commonly ~20-25 TPS for peak hours.
- Initial monthly budget: $3k - $5k (we have a small trial budget, larger budget if performance/unit economics look good).
- Target unit economics: Ideally around $100 / 1M tokens or better.

Two quick questions: do you have an SLA/uptime guarantee for Hosted API, and can we get access to basic request-level logs for audit/debugging?

Thanks — happy to take the 30-min follow-up. I’m generally available Thu/Fri afternoons PST.

—Oliver
CTO, FinLytics
oliver@finlytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Zhang <oliver@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volume & peak TPS

Perfect — thanks for the detail, Oliver. That range gives us everything we need for a pragmatic estimate. Quick notes based on the numbers you shared:

- Cost check: at your target of $100 / 1M tokens, 30M tokens would be ~$3k/month, which is within your stated initial budget. We’ll run a more precise projection that includes request/response token split and expected caching savings.
- Peaks: 40 TPS spikes are manageable on Hosted API; for short launch bursts we recommend enabling burst capacity and a brief warm-up plan so you don’t see cold-start latency. If spikes are sustained regularly, Dedicated capacity becomes more cost-effective.
- Logs and SLA: Hosted includes request-level logs (configurable retention) and we have SLA add-ons for uptime and latency guarantees — Ben can share the standard SLA language.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben — can you scope a quick perf checklist (sample traffic pattern + representative prompts) and confirm if a sandbox perf run is feasible?
2) Oliver — once Ben confirms, let’s book 30 minutes Thu/Fri to review the perf and a line-item pricing estimate.

I’ve attached the hosted pricing sheet we discussed and linked the HubSpot deal for reference.

Thanks — Marissa

Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-sheet.xlsx
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Zhang <oliver@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volume & peak TPS

Thanks — looping in a quick technical note from the SE side.

- 40 TPS short spikes: for hosted we recommend either (a) burst capacity enabled on the account and a short warm-up of concurrent connections, or (b) if spikes will be longer than ~15-30 minutes and consistently frequent, consider Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency and cost.
- To size properly I’ll need: a sample of representative prompts (avg tokens in/out), expected concurrency during peak hour, and whether you intend to use streaming or non-streaming responses.
- We can run a sandbox perf test (no charge) — I’ll need an hour window with a replayed traffic pattern. If you can share sample prompts and a short hour-by-minute TPS estimate, I’ll schedule the perf run and report latency percentiles and token throughput.

Proposed times for the perf run / call: Thu 2026-07-23 10:00-12:00 PST or Fri 2026-07-24 14:00-16:00 PST. Let me know which works and I’ll block time.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
